focus_areas: Material realism of the rubber surface (sheen vs. matte)
Geometric consistency of the rink boards
Contact shadow and grounding of the puck
Edge sharpness between puck and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the material properties of the puck. Real hockey pucks are matte black rubber; AI often renders them as shiny plastic. Check if the 'glossiness' is an artifact of lighting or a material generation error. Also, verify if the background boards have logical continuity or if they warp nonsensically.
image_description: A close-up shot of a black hockey puck resting on the white, curved boards of an ice hockey rink. The puck is positioned in the lower-left foreground, showing its cylindrical shape and side ridges. The background features the glossy, slightly reflective surface of the rink boards with some indistinct markings.

expert_testimonies.reason: To verify the spatial relationship between the puck and the boards, ensuring the contact point is physically grounded and not floating.
To confirm the object is correctly classified as a hockey puck and not a similar cylindrical object (e.g., tire, button).
To check for edge bleeding or fusion between the black puck and the white boards, which is a common artifact in high-contrast areas.
To assess the realism of the lighting, shadows, and material textures, specifically checking for the 'plastic' look noted in artifacts.
